verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only the single-message SendEmail API, including Templated messages with personalization tags. Nothing in the pack shows a bulk or batch send endpoint that handles many personalized messages in one request, and nothing shows per-message status in a response. Templated single sends are an adjacent capability and do not cover the batch requirement.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a batch of personalized emails in a single API request with per-message status in the response, instead of looping one call per recipient
